rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (28 tracks) per https://usstore.edsheeran.com/products/autumn-variations-fan-living-room-sessions?eml=2023October2%2F6216702%2F6010037&etsubid=187823981&lf=bba9b4038a25103579484dddb8dadf33, https://tidal.com/browse/track/318903496. 28 tracks total (1:32:52 per TIDAL). Tracks 1-14 are the standard studio album Autumn Variations (2023). Tracks 15-28 are the Fan Living Room Sessions bonus: each of the 14 album tracks re-recorded live/acoustic in a different fan's living room, recorded over 2 days (per Ed's official store message). The track title suffix is 'Live from <fan's> Living Room'. Fan names: Brantlie, Maynard, Kia, Alex, Sarom, Kari, Narine, Deborah, John, Emily, Holly, Kristen, Danielle, Keira.
